subject: Lisa Kingsley School Committee Candidacy
overview: The Medford Bites podcast interviewed school committee candidate Dr. Lisa Kingsley about her professional background in special education and administration. Kingsley discussed her campaign priorities, including the upcoming superintendent search, strategic planning, and enhancing community engagement.

items.title: Introduction and Medford Eatery Favorites
items.summary: Host Danielle Balocca introduced school committee candidate Dr. Lisa Kingsley, who shared her favorite local food spots, including Goldilocks Bagels and Bob's.

items.title: Professional Background and Decision to Run
items.summary: Kingsley detailed her career in special education and school administration, including serving as the principal of Curtis Tufts High School, and explained how her doctoral training motivated her to run for school committee.

items.title: The Upcoming Superintendent Search
items.summary: Kingsley emphasized that the school committee's next term will involve hiring a permanent superintendent and argued her training makes her uniquely qualified to assist with this process.

items.title: Enhancing Educational Equity and Special Education
items.summary: Kingsley advocated for creating a robust district-wide strategic plan and shifting special education from a compliance-oriented mindset to a family partnership model.

items.title: National Political Climate and Curriculum
items.summary: Kingsley expressed gratitude for Massachusetts' educational environment and argued that local school districts should utilize their freedom to engage in honest, responsive conversations with families.

items.title: Community Engagement and Street Data
items.summary: Kingsley outlined her strategy to gather qualitative feedback directly from parents and community members to ensure diverse voices shape district decisions.

items.title: Medford Family Network Recruitment and Campaign Events
items.summary: Kingsley promoted board openings for the Medford Family Network and plugged her upcoming campaign meet-and-greet on September 25th at Colleen's.
